plugins.name: nyra
plugins.description: Nyra bookkeeping by Otterz. Connects Claude to your live books — P&L, balance sheet, cash position, and transactions from your general ledger — and lets you send receipts, bills, and statements in for processing, answer your bookkeeper's open questions, and flag anything that looks wrong. Read-only on the ledger: every posting stays in the supervised approval queue.
